turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: What brings you in?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Hi, I was just really worried. My son just yesterday night I noticed that he was making these grunting noises and I did notice that he was a bit warm yesterday as well, and today I, he just hasn't been himself, just very, very irritable, crying a lot. Yeah, I just got bit worried.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Yeah, for sure. What started first?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I would say the there was a little bit of coughing earlier, like yesterday. But then later on during the night, it kind of turned into this grunting noise, and he's kind of like his chest is moving a lot more when he's taking a breath in and all that.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. Uhm did you measure his temperature at home?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, so I think it was 38.5 degrees Celsius.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and did you do that orally or rectal or under armpit?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I did it under the armpit.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. OK, uhm so you mentioned that he's had a fever, he's been grunting and he just seems a little bit more fussy. Is that right?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK is he coughing at all?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: He was yesterday but not really now.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK and was it a dry cough?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I think so. I mean, not-nothing really came out.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, that's good. So no blood, no sputum?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and did he seem wheezy?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh, no.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: No, OK. So there's no wheezing with the grunting?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Maybe a little bit like that, just a little bit of a noise, but it's mostly the grunting.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. Has he had any weight loss?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, not that I really, we haven't really weighed him now since his last appointment.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. Does he seem excessively tired or fatigued?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uhm, moreso today I would say he's like earlier, he was very fussy, but now he seems a bit more tired.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. Any rashes that you've noticed?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: No, OK. Uhm any changes in his vision or hearing?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh, no, not that I can tell.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: No, OK. So he's responding to like sounds and he's still looking at you and things like that?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. Have you noticed a runny nose or stuffy nose?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uhm, no, nothing like that.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: No, OK. And he said he hasn't had any like fainting spells?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh, no, I don't think so.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: No, OK. And how many wet diapers is he producing in a day now?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Probably 5 or 6.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: 5 or 6 OK. Has that changed from before?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, it's pretty much the same.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and uhm any changes to his bowel movements?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: No. How about his urine?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: No, OK. OK. And then you said he was fussy, is he still eating and drinking OK?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh no, today he's not really taking anything in, like very fussy, very hard to feed him today.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, is he crying a lot?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Earlier today was crying a lot, but now has calm down and just I guess tired himself out.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Yeah, OK. Alright, and is he an otherwise healthy child?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah he was, he was premature by three weeks so, Other than that like I remember when he was born they did have earlier some issues with his oxygen not being high enough and they had to like keeping, keep us in the hospital for a bit longer.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK.

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: But yeah, after that, like there haven't really been too many concerns.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, so he's hitting all the developmental milestones like in terms of motor movements, ah speech, behaviour, all of that?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, no issues there so far.

turns.text: OK, and how about medications? Is he on any?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.text: No medications, OK. And is up to date with all his immunizations?

turns.text: Yeah, oh he had all his immunizations so far.

turns.text: OK. How about allergies? Does he have any?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Not that I know of.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: No, OK. Any family history of lung or heart conditions?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and does anyone at home smoke?

turns.text: Uh, no, not that I know of. Uhm his older sister does go to school though, but I don't know if she might have carried something home.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, how old is she?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: She's six years old.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Six, OK. And is she healthy or is she having similar symptoms?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, she's healthy. No, no symptoms.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. Any travel recently?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: No, OK. And who does he live with at home?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh, so his older sister, me and his mother.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, any reasons to believe like you have old carpets, dust, mold, asbestos, pets, anything like that that could worsen his symptoms?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh, no nothing like that.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, so I think those are all the questions that I had for you. Did you have any questions or any concerns? Anything that I missed that you wanted to add?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, I think that was all.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, uhm so for him we'll do a Covid swab just to rule that out because some of his symptoms do overlap with that. Uhm, we can get his temperature, get his oxygen oxygen saturation right away we'll get a chest x-ray. We'll do some blood work as well and uhm, he might need to be admitted depending on uhm, the oxygen, oxygen saturation and the fact that he's grunting. Yeah, does that sound OK?

turns.label: Patient

turns.label: Clinician
